meta.name: orchestration
meta.description: Coordinate supervised Orca workers: threaded messages, blocking ask/reply, task dispatch, worker_done/escalation waits, task DAGs, decision gates, coordinator loops, and decomposing work across agents. Use `orca-cli` for full ownership handoffs — "hand off", "handoff", "handover", "give this to another agent", "another worktree" — unless asked to supervise, monitor, or coordinate a DAG, and for terminal control, lightweight terminal prompts, shell commands, Orca worktree management, and reading or waiting on terminals.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把一件大活拆给多个 AI 小组分头做,并盯着它们回报进度直到收尾
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果同时有好几个 AI 任务在跑,需要有人分派、盯梢并汇总结果
copy.tagline_en: Split a big job across several AI workers and supervise them through to completion
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run several AI tasks at once and need someone to dispatch, track and merge results

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会用 Orca 协调多个受监督的 worker:线程消息、阻塞式 ask/reply、任务派发、等待 worker_done/升级、任务 DAG,也能把工作拆给不同 agent。跑 Orca 命令前会先取版本匹配的指南。
howto.when: 需要结构化多 agent 协调时接管,如线程消息、ask/reply、任务 DAG 等;若只是说 “hand off”“handover” 做所有权交接、没要求监督或协调 DAG,则改用 orca-cli。

say.text: 帮我协调几个 worker 并行做这个任务,用任务 DAG 编排
say.note: 会先取 Orca 编排指南再派发

say.text: 给那个 worker 发消息,然后阻塞等它回复
等 worker_done 或升级通知,再决定下一步
say.note: 按等待与升级流程处理

howto.what_en: Claude uses the Orca runtime to coordinate supervised workers: threaded messages, blocking ask/reply, task dispatch, worker_done/escalation waits, task DAGs and decision gates. It loads the version-matched guide first.
howto.when_en: Engages for structured multi-agent coordination: threaded messages, ask/reply, task DAGs. For plain handoffs ("hand off", "handover") with no supervision or DAG coordination, use orca-cli instead.

say_en.text: Coordinate several workers on this task with a task DAG
say_en.note: Loads the Orca guide, then dispatches

say_en.text: Message that worker and block until it replies
Wait for worker_done or an escalation, then decide next
